This is the new Mechatronik M SEC, a restomodded version of the 1980s Mercedes SEC super-coupe. Mechatronik takes Merc’s big two-door barge as a basis, strips it to a bare shell, and rebuilds it with a carbonfibre widebody and a naturally aspirated 6.3-litre V8. It’s the ultimate sleeper V8, an awesome Q-car, and it might just be the best Mercedes on sale today!
Mechatronik M SEC (Mercedes SEC)
